abstract: Struma ovarii has elicited considerable interest because of its many unique features since Ludwig Pick first elucidated its relationship to teratoma in the early part of the 20th century. In this article, we report 3 cases of papillary and 1 of follicular thyroid carcinoma; 2 of these cases were associated with mature cystic teratoma. Metastases occurred in 2 patients, and 1 died of neoplasm. In regard to the occurrence of thyroid-type carcinoma in struma ovarii, precise terminology should be used, and the expression malignant struma ovarii was avoided as a diagnostic term. Upon review of the literature, papillary carcinoma and follicular carcinoma are the most frequent types of malignancy to occur in ovarian struma; other forms of thyroid carcinoma occur only rarely. The diagnostic criteria for cases of papillary carcinoma are similar to those described in the cervical thyroid gland and are based primarily on nuclear and architectural features. In reference to follicular carcinoma, invasion into the surrounding ovarian tissue, vascular invasion, or metastasis is evidence of malignancy. Histological malignancy in a struma does not necessarily equate with biological malignancy, and the majority of thyroid-type carcinomas do not spread beyond the ovary. Occasionally, metastases of ovarian struma have an innocuous histological appearance, and such cases are referred to as highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin (HDFCO). Because its histological appearance resembles that of nonneoplastic thyroid, HDFCO characteristically cannot be diagnosed until the neoplasm spreads beyond the ovary. In this article, we apply the term typical thyroid carcinoma to those forms of thyroid malignancy arising in ovarian struma that closely resemble the types described in the cervical thyroid gland to distinguish them from HDFCO. Typical follicular carcinoma is more aggressive than the somewhat more common papillary carcinoma, and HDFCO is the least aggressive of these tumor types. Cases of thyroid-type carcinoma arising in the ovary sometimes lack evidence of preexisting struma. The more aggressive thyroid-type neoplasms can arise in thyroid tissue within a mature cystic teratoma, or they may overgrow and replace the struma. Primary thyroid-type carcinoma must be distinguished from rare instances of ovarian metastases that originate in the cervical thyroid gland and the less differentiated forms from other ovarian neoplasms such as clear cell adenocarcinoma and tumors with an oxyphilic appearance. In the differential diagnosis with other ovarian neoplasms, cases of thyroid-type carcinoma associated with strumal carcinoid should not be diagnosed as malignant strumal carcinoid because the latter diagnosis might lead to suboptimal therapy.
abstract_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は、20世紀初頭にLudwig Pickが奇形腫との関係を初めて明らかにして以来、その多くの独特な特徴により大きな関心を集めてきた。本論文では、乳頭癌3例と濾胞癌1例の計4例を報告する。このうち2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴っていた。2例に転移が生じ、1例は腫瘍により死亡した。卵巣甲状腺腫に発生する甲状腺型癌については正確な用語を用いるべきであり、「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」という診断用語は避けるべきである。文献レビューの結果、卵巣甲状腺腫で最も多い悪性腫瘍は乳頭癌と濾胞癌であり、他の型の甲状腺癌はまれである。乳頭癌の診断基準は頸部甲状腺のものに類似しており、主として核と構造の特徴に基づく。濾胞癌については、周囲の卵巣組織への浸潤、血管浸潤、または転移があれば悪性の根拠となる。組織学的な悪性所見が必ずしも生物学的な悪性を意味するわけではなく、甲状腺型癌の大多数は卵巣外へ広がらない。まれに、頸部甲状腺に由来する卵巣転移や、明細胞腺癌、好酸性様の外観を示す腫瘍など、他の卵巣腫瘍のより未分化な型と鑑別する必要がある。他の卵巣腫瘍との鑑別診断において、甲状腺型癌に伴う甲状腺類カルチノイドを悪性甲状腺類カルチノイドと診断すべきではない。後者の診断は不適切な治療につながりうるためである。
